tool_description: Digital Eye for Mammography is a comprehensive toolkit and benchmark for mass detection and classification in mammograms. It provides multiple state-of-the-art models including ATSS, Cascade R-CNN, Deformable DETR, DETR, DoubleHead R-CNN, Dynamic R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, FCOS, RetinaNet, VarifocalNet, and YOLOv3, with support for model ensemble and breast segmentation preprocessing.
demo_commands:
# Using Python for Digital Eye Mammography
# Step 1: Navigate to the project directory and run with ensemble enabled
(cd /path/to/digitaleye-mammography && python mass_inference.py \
    --model_enum 0 1 2 \
    --img_path ./images \
    --classify_mass True \
    --segment_breast True \
    --enable_ensemble True)

# Using Python with specific model selection
(cd /path/to/digitaleye-mammography && python mass_inference.py \
    --model_enum 3 8 10 \
    --img_path ./images \
    --classify_mass False)

# Using Python with custom thresholds
(cd /path/to/digitaleye-mammography && python mass_inference.py \
    --model_enum 2 4 5 7 9 \
    --img_path ./images \
    --enable_ensemble True \
    --nms_iou_threshold 0.1 \
    --confidence_threshold 0.33 \
    --ap_threshold 0.5)

image_path.description: Path to the input mammogram images directory.

items.description: Model selection: 0=ATSS, 1=Cascade R-CNN, 2=Deformable DETR, 3=DETR, 4=DoubleHead R-CNN, 5=Dynamic R-CNN, 6=Faster R-CNN, 7=FCOS, 8=RetinaNet, 9=VarifocalNet, 10=YOLOv3

classify_mass.description: Whether to classify masses as benign or malignant.

segment_breast.description: Whether to perform breast segmentation preprocessing.

ap_threshold.description: IoU threshold for determining true positives.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2]

models_used.description: List of models used for detection
